title: Terry Funk’s last great ECW championship stand
summary: Terry Funk becomes the emotional centerpiece of ECW’s pay-per-view debut. His late-career title run ends in a punishing encounter with Sabu.

chapters.title: Two matches, one championship
chapters.result: Funk wins the three-way contender match, then defeats Raven for the world title.
chapters.context: The exhausted veteran gives ECW’s first pay-per-view its emotional closing victory.

chapters.title: Sabu takes the belt in barbed wire
chapters.result: Sabu defeats Funk for the world championship.
chapters.context: The no-ropes barbed-wire match ends Funk’s reign and leaves both men tangled in the wreckage.
